notes:
# v1.3.22 — Mgeko source back online

- Fixed: the Mgeko source returned no results and reported a TLS/certificate
  error. The cause was not an expired certificate on Mgeko itself — it was local
  network DNS interference returning the wrong server for the Mgeko host, which
  made the secure connection fail. Mgeko's host is now resolved correctly, so
  search, popular listings, details and chapters work again, with full
  certificate validation preserved.
- Fixed: Mgeko cover images hosted on the same affected host now load again
  through the image proxy.
- Note: this is a network-resolution fix only; nothing about your library or
  reading progress changes.
